placeholders.<DEVICE_ID>: `dev_` + 16 lowercase hex: the device registration (`POST presence/devices`)
placeholders.<INSTALL_ID>: the install id that registration holds (8-64 characters)
placeholders.<NEW_KEY_SIGNATURE>: base64url ES256 signature by the NEW key over the `mint` message
placeholders.<NEW_PUBLIC_KEY>: base64url of the NEW key's SPKI DER (Android) or 65-byte X9.63 point (iOS)
placeholders.<OLD_KEY_SIGNATURE>: base64url ES256 signature by the OLD (pinned) key over the `replace` message
placeholders.<OLD_PUBLIC_KEY>: base64url of the key the device is pinned to
placeholders.<ORIGIN>: `<scheme>://<host[:port]>` of the server, exactly as the app stored it (contract section 0)
placeholders.<OTHER_KEY_SIGNATURE>: base64url ES256 signature by a key that is not the pinned one
placeholders.<PINNED_KEY_MINT_SIGNATURE>: base64url ES256 signature by the pinned key itself over the `mint` message (the same key again)
placeholders.<SERVER_CORRELATION_ID>: the server's own correlation id (12 lowercase hex)
placeholders.<SESSION_COOKIE>: the web view's Arx session cookie from a sign-in at most 15 minutes old (the app's native call carries it)
placeholders.<UNIX_SECONDS_SKEWED>: a JSON integer more than 300 s away from the server clock
placeholders.<UNKNOWN_NONCE>: a nonce-shaped value the server never issued
